# Role Policies Reference

Complete reference for the `glassfrog policies` and `glassfrog policy` commands — the policies governing a role's interior, read either as a role's list or one policy by its own id (including its full body).

## Overview

Policies are exposed as **two sibling commands**:

- `glassfrog policies <ROLE_ID>` **lists** the policies governing a role (`GET /roles/{id}/policies`). Paginated — walks every page by default.
- `glassfrog policy <POL_ID>` **reads one policy** by its own id (`GET /policies/{id}`), including its full body verbatim. Not paginated.

This is the *addressable* policy surface — distinct from Role Reads' embedded convenience view (`glassfrog roles <id> --include policies`). The two coexist deliberately and share the same underlying `Policy` model.

Codebase enrichment skipped — not attempted. This reference is based on the interface contracts and the shipped `--help`.

## `glassfrog policies <ROLE_ID>` — list a role's policies

### Synopsis

```
glassfrog policies <ROLE_ID> [--query TEXT] [--first-page] [--per-page N] [--base-url URL] [-o FORMAT]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ROLE_ID` | string | required | The role whose policies to list (`role_…`). Exactly one required (`cobra.ExactArgs(1)`); zero or more than one is a usage error, no API call. Not validated locally; an unknown/malformed id → `404`. |

### List flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--query` | `-q` | string | — | Free-text search, sent verbatim as the endpoint's `q` parameter. Sent only when the flag is present and non-empty; `--query ""` behaves as no filter. Not validated locally. |
| `--first-page` | — | bool | false | Fetch only the first page and signal if more exist (see [Completeness signalling](#completeness-signalling)). |
| `--per-page` | — | int | API max | Page size for the walk. The API owns the valid range. |

### List output

Rendered in the resolved format. Format changes rendering, not fetch depth: the list walks to completion in every format (and `--first-page` limits all formats to one page).

**`full`** — one block per policy, blocks separated by a blank line:

```
<Policy Title> (pol_0123…)
  Role:   <role_… | (org-level — no role)>
  Domain: <dom_… | (whole-role — no domain)>
  Body:
    <full policy body | (no body set)>
```

**`compact`** — one line per policy, id first then double-space-separated fragments:

```
pol_0123…  <Policy Title>  role=<role_…|—>  domain=<dom_…|—>
```

**`json` / `yaml`** — the structured document, each policy's bytes preserved verbatim; a valid empty list is `{"data": []}`, never `null`.

**Empty list** (the role has no policies, or none matched `--query`): under `full`/`compact`, stdout is exactly `No policies.` and the command exits `0`.

## `glassfrog policy <POL_ID>` — single read

### Synopsis

```
glassfrog policy <POL_ID> [--base-url URL] [-o FORMAT]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POL_ID` | string | required | The policy to read (`pol_…`). Exactly one required. Passed through unvalidated; an unknown id → `404`. |

`policy` declares **no list flags** — passing `--query`/`-q`, `--first-page`, or `--per-page` is rejected by cobra as an unknown flag (usage error, exit `2`, no request). This is how "the search filter applies only to the list" is enforced structurally.

### Single-read output

**`full`** — the policy block with the full body rendered verbatim (never truncated or reflowed), plus `created_at`/`updated_at` shown with explicit-absence guards.

**`compact`** — one line, body omitted:

```
pol_0123…  <Policy Title>  role=<role_…|—>  domain=<dom_…|—>
```

**`json` / `yaml`** — the API's single-policy document verbatim.

## Projection fields

### Policy (list and single)

| Field | Notes |
|---|---|
| Title | Policy title; rendered with the id, e.g. `<Policy Title> (pol_0123…)`. |
| Role | The governed role's id; `(org-level — no role)` when absent. |
| Domain | The domain the policy scopes to; `(whole-role — no domain)` when absent. |
| Body | The full policy body, rendered verbatim in `full` (list and single); `(no body set)` when empty. Omitted in `compact`. |
| Created / Updated | Timestamps; shown in the single read's `full` with explicit-absence guards. |

## Completeness signalling

Applies to `policies` (the list). A partial list is never silently presented as complete — signalled via a note on **stderr**.

| Situation | Behaviour | Exit |
|---|---|---|
| Default (full walk) | Walks every page and renders the complete set. | 0 |
| `--first-page`, more pages exist | Renders the first page; writes to stderr: `note: more policies exist than shown; re-run without --first-page to fetch all` | 0 |
| Mid-walk failure | Renders policies gathered so far; writes to stderr: `note: result is incomplete — <cause>; the policies shown are a partial set` | non-zero |

The single `policy` read is unpaginated — no completeness signalling.

## Output formats

Inherited persistent root flags, read by cobra inheritance:

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--base-url URL` | Override the API base URL (top rung of the base-URL precedence chain). |
| `-o`, `--output FORMAT` | `full` (default), `compact`, `json`, or `yaml` — or, at the flag only, a user-template ref (a template file path, or `stdin`; see [User-Defined Template Output](user-defined-template-output.md)). Resolution chain: flag → `GLASSFROG_OUTPUT` → `.glassfrogrc output` → `full` (env/config accept only the four tokens). |

The raw API envelope is never emitted under a human format.

## Exit codes and errors

Failure rendering is **format-aware** (Output-Aware Failure Rendering): under `json`/`yaml` a failure emits the unified error envelope on **stdout** (so an agent parses success and failure the same way); under `full`/`compact` the diagnostic goes to **stderr**. The incompleteness note stays on **stderr** in every format. The exit code is the category from the Exit-Code Convention. Every diagnostic names the cause and a next step, and never includes the token.

| Condition | Exit | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|
| Policies listed / policy read (incl. empty list) | 0 | — (result on stdout; incompleteness note on stderr when applicable) |
| No usable token | 2 | "not authenticated — run `glassfrog auth login` or set GLASSFROG_TOKEN" |
| Unreadable / malformed credential file | 1 | names the path — "fix or remove the malformed `.glassfrogrc`" |
| Unknown/forbidden role or policy id, or other non-2xx (4xx/5xx) | 3 / 4 / 5 | names the HTTP status + extracted detail; per-class next step |
| Could not reach the wire | 6 | names the transport failure + host — "check network access and the base URL" |
| 2xx body did not match the expected shape | 3 | "the API response did not match the expected shape — may be an API change; report it" |
| Malformed paging mid-walk (`policies`) | 1 | "the API returned malformed pagination — partial set shown" |
| Base-URL configuration error | 2 | names the malformed base URL + source |
| Invalid `--output` selector | 2 | names the bad format value + the four valid names |
| List-only flag on `policy`, or wrong positional count (zero / >1) | 2 | cobra's unknown-flag / arg-count message; no request sent |

Exit codes by category: `0` success, `1` runtime error, `2` usage error, `3` API error, `4` permission error, `5` rate-limited, `6` network unavailable.
